title: Pinned fixtures and goldens remain the accepted contract
intended_use: An X-Verse engineer confirms that the committed T017 fixtures still decode and that their recorded and recomputed digests and file hashes equal the pinned goldens.
expected: Fixture decode, recorded/recomputed digest, and file hash equal the pinned goldens; drift fails the suite.
environment: candidate checkout, offline; goldens captured from the accepted artifacts at the candidate revision.
